integrity: The orbit classification is proved from the recoverable colored macro-tree; finite computation checks only the resulting enumeration and recurrence.
scientific_limitations: The Padovan sequence and plastic constant are classical and are not claimed as new. Originality is limited to the exact radial stabilizer-orbit interpretation for this weak Fraïssé generic limit and the accompanying three vertex-orbit classification; unindexed folklore remains a residual risk.
title: Padovan radial orbit profile of a weak Fraïssé generic tree
